title: fix(app-shell): the hook object picker flags and says "publish" only from an answered roster (objectui#10585)
body:
Fixes #10585
Clause-②: no

The Hook inspector's object picker made two claims from its object catalog off the list alone: a selected object the catalog does not list was flagged `(not published)`, and an empty list printed "No objects found — publish an object, then pick it here." The list is `[]` while the fetch is in flight and after it fails, exactly as for a catalog with no objects, so both claims fired before the roster answered, and permanently on a failure. This applies the objectui#8862 / objectui#9651 rule: only an ANSWERED roster may make a claim.

## What changed

- `previews/useObjectOptions.ts`: returns a third fact, `error: string | null`, beside the unchanged `options` / `loading`. Spelled the way `useObjectFields` spells it: `err?.message ?? String(err)` in the `catch`. `error` is reset to `null` at the start of every fetch. The answer branch does not touch it, so it stays `null` through an answer. `rosterFrom({ loading, error })` therefore reads both hooks alike. The header comment is rewritten to be true: a failure still leaves `options` empty (the action and page-block pickers still fall back to free text), and it now also sets `error`.
- `inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx`: reads the roster through `rosterFrom`.
  - answered: unchanged. An absent selected object is flagged, and an empty catalog prints the "publish an object" copy.
  - in flight: a selected object is drawn bare, with no flag. The empty list prints `engine.form.loadingOptions` ("Loading options…").
  - failed: a selected object is drawn bare, with no flag, and stays toggleable (pinned: un-ticking it reaches the draft). The empty list box is not drawn. A `role="status"` notice renders `engine.form.optionsLoadFailedTitle` plus the cause.
- The notice repeats the markup of the failure notice `InspectorSelectField` renders (same role, tone, title key and cause span). That notice is inlined in the primitive in `_shared.tsx` and not exported, `_shared.tsx` is read-only for this card, and this picker is a checkbox list, not a select. No new i18n key.
- `.changeset/10585-hook-object-roster-state.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`.

## Census (the card's H2, measured)

`previews/useObjectOptions.ts` has exactly three importers on main: `ActionDefaultInspector`, `HookDefaultInspector` and `PageBlockInspector` (`git grep` for the import specifier). `DatasetDefaultInspector` and `ViewVariantInspector` import a different same-name hook from `inspectors/useDatasetFields.ts`. `ObjectFieldInspector` declares a third, file-local `useObjectOptions(locale)`.

- **ActionDefaultInspector**: left unchanged. Its `ObjectPicker` gates on `{options.length === 0 ? (` `InspectorTextField` …, so an empty roster renders a free-text input. It shows no flag and no empty-state copy. A throwaway probe (real hook, stubbed client, not committed) read:
  - in flight: a text `INPUT` holding `ghost_object`, flag false, "publish" copy false;
  - failed: the same;
  - answered without the object: `ghost_object (not found)`, which is a correct claim.
- **PageBlockInspector**: left unchanged. Its `ObjectPickerField` has the same gate, `if (options.length === 0) {` `return` `InspectorTextField` …. This one was not probed at runtime; the conclusion rests on that line.
- **HookDefaultInspector**: the only caller with the shape. It is fixed here.

## Tests

New: `HookDefaultInspector.rosterFailure.test.tsx` (8 cases, mirroring `ViewColumnInspector.rosterFailure.test.tsx`) and `previews/useObjectOptions.test.tsx` (3 cases).

- **Red on base.** The two source files were checked out at base `b1030c71a` with the new tests kept. The on-disk blobs matched the base blobs, and the markers `rosterFrom` / `setError` counted 0. Result at head `e5a135708`: `Tests 9 failed | 2 passed (11)`. The two that pass are the answered-arm CONTROLS, as designed. The editability case is red on base because its bare-named checkbox does not exist there (the base label is flagged). Restore used `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.
- **Green on head** `e5a135708`: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 11 passed (11)`. The editability case alone, verbose: `✓ … leaves the selection EDITABLE after the failure — un-ticking it reaches the draft 207ms` (`Tests 1 passed | 7 skipped (8)`). At `cab28b435`, the run with the existing `HookDefaultInspector.flag.i18n-10448.test.tsx` read `Test Files 3 passed (3) · Tests 13 passed (13)`.
- **Per-hunk ablation** of the inspector's guards, measured at `cab28b435` against the 7-case suite, used `ablation-replace.mjs`. Every anchor hit exactly once, every mutation was proven on disk by a blob change, and every restore was proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - A, flag guard (`rosterAnswered ? flagUnknownValue(…) : n` becomes always-flag): `2 failed | 5 passed`. The failed-arm "not published" row and the in-flight bare row went red.
  - B, empty-copy guard (`{rosterAnswered` becomes `{true`): `1 failed | 6 passed`. "does not tell the author to publish an object while loading" went red.
  - C, failed-hides-list (the box condition becomes `true &&`): `1 failed | 6 passed`. The failed-arm row "a failed request is no longer in flight" went red.
  - D, the failure notice (`{false && (`): `1 failed | 6 passed`. "tells the author the roster failed, and names the cause" went red.
  - The first ablation attempt was a no-op. The copied tool was missing its sibling module `invoked-as.mjs` (MODULE_NOT_FOUND), so nothing mutated. It was re-run with that module present, and the readings above come from the re-run.

## Local verification

- **Round 3 (head `a1c3d2984`)**: one changeset sentence changed, from "The Hook inspector reads the three through `rosterFrom`" to "The Hook inspector folds `loading` and `error` through `rosterFrom`". The frontmatter md5 is `4e8ce55021fe3b14329c8b4cb3f9f354` both before and after. `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check:control-bytes` all exit 0. `git merge-tree` against `f99f9cde7` exit 0.
- **Round 2 (head `e5a135708`)** changed only a test case and one changeset sentence. At this head:
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"
  - `check-changeset-no-major`: "No changeset declares a `major` bump"
  - `check:control-bytes`: OK
  - ESLint on the edited test file: 0 errors, 0 warnings
  - the two new test files: see Tests
  - The changeset frontmatter is byte-identical to round 1 (md5 of the first three lines unchanged).
  - Type-check was NOT re-run at this head (the closure build is gone with the round-1 worktree). CI's `type-check` covers the new case.
- Everything below was measured at the round-1 head `cab28b435`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. That covers `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `--listFilesOnly` confirms both new test files and both edited sources are in the programs. The dependency closure was built first with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`: exit 0.
- **Tests, declared narrowing.** The 54 test files that name `HookDefaultInspector`, `ActionDefaultInspector`, `PageBlockInspector`, `useObjectOptions` or `default-inspector-registry` passed: `Test Files 54 passed (54) · Tests 528 passed (528)`.
  - The full-package run `vitest run packages/app-shell/` is NOT MEASURED. I stopped it myself at 24m56s holding the shared verify lock (exit 143) because it was starving four queued sibling agents.
  - Blind spot of the narrowing: a test that reaches these modules only through the `inspectors/index.ts` barrel, without naming them. CI runs the full sharded suite.
- Gates at `cab28b435`, each exit 0 with its own verdict line:
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"
  - `check-changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite`
  - `check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)"
  - `check:control-bytes`
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`
  - `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:pending-changeset-literals` and `check:unreferenced-sources`
- **ESLint, narrowed to the 4 touched files.**
  - Population: each file is in `eslint.config.js`'s scope, and the `--format json` run returned 4 results with no ignore notice.
  - Result: 0 errors and 4 warnings. All 4 warnings (`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` on the effect's opening `setLoading(true)`, and three `no-explicit-any` in the mapper) are present on the base version of the file too, read through `--stdin`. The inspector has 0 findings before and after.
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` configures no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main HEAD`: exit 0 against `eca276070` in round 1 and against `f99f9cde7` in round 2. Main did not move in any file this PR touches, so no merge commit was made.

## Pending changesets (H6)

`git grep -l -E "HookDefaultInspector|useObjectOptions|ActionDefaultInspector|PageBlockInspector" origin/main -- .changeset` returns 10 pending changesets. None describes the object picker's roster behaviour, and no sentence in them is falsified by this change.

The closest is `10448-designer-invalid-not-published-flags.md`: "the Hook inspector's object picker flagged a selected object the live catalog does not list `(not published)`". It stays true, because the flag still fires once the catalog has answered. The 8862 and 9651 family changesets describe `InspectorSelectField` call sites, which this change does not touch.

## Acceptance notes

- The same-name hook in `inspectors/useDatasetFields.ts` has the same missing failure state. Its `catch` sets `{ options: [], loading: false }`, and nothing else. The probe read a failed fetch and an answered-empty fetch as byte-identical `{"options":[],"loading":false}`.
  - Its two callers, `DatasetDefaultInspector`'s "Base object" and `ViewVariantInspector`'s object picker, render `InspectorComboField`. That field draws a stored value raw, with no absence flag.
  - On an empty list, its popover shows the generic `emptyText` "No match — keep typing to use a custom value.", with no failure notice.
  - The objectui#9651 changeset deliberately left `InspectorComboField` without a fault arm. Out of scope here, and not merged with this hook.
- On a failed catalog, `ActionDefaultInspector` and `PageBlockInspector` degrade to a text box with no failure notice. They make no false claim, but the failure goes unsaid: this is the objectui#9651 "silence" concern, a distinct and lesser class. Not fixed here.
- The third same-name hook, the file-local one in `ObjectFieldInspector`, was assessed by the contract reviewer as not reachable with this defect: it feeds a datalist input and renders no flag and no empty-state copy.
- On a failed roster with nothing selected, the Hook picker offers no way to add an object other than "All objects (*)" or the JSON source. That was already true on an answered-empty catalog. A free-text fallback would be new surface, so it is not added here.
